context:
Treat `get_platform_skip_queries(platform_name)` as a SQL-visible hook. Only
put entries there when the skip is valid for SQL execution as well as any
other execution mode. Introduce a separate DataFrame-specific platform hook
for DataFrame-only workarounds and update `BenchmarkExecutionMixin` to call
that hook.

In `dataframe_queries.py`, keep skip lists aligned to actual support:
family-wide lists should only contain true all-expression-family gaps, Polars
should own Map dtype gaps, DataFusion should own DataFusion DataFrame API gaps,
and PySpark should own the list higher-order gaps unless PySpark-native
implementations are added with tests.

Prefer narrow tests that assert the dispatch contract directly. The SQL
regression was missed because commit 4a2b00043 added DataFrame mixin tests but
no SQL adapter test around the shared hook.
description:
A review of commits 7c61f2ac9 and 4a2b00043 found that read-primitives query
skip dispatch now conflates SQL platform skips with DataFrame platform skips.
The immediate correctness bug is that DataFusion SQL loses valid catalog
variants because a DataFrame-only skip list was moved into the generic
`get_platform_skip_queries(platform_name)` hook, which is also consumed by the
SQL adapter.

The concrete regression:
- `ReadPrimitivesBenchmark.get_platform_skip_queries("DataFusion")` returns
  `get_skip_for_datafusion()`.
- `get_skip_for_datafusion()` is documented as DataFusion DataFrame mode only
  and contains `list_filter`, `list_transform`, `list_reduce`, and
  `array_distinct`.
- `PlatformAdapter._filter_queries()` applies `get_platform_skip_queries()` in
  the SQL path after DataFusion dialect query selection.
- The SQL catalog has DataFusion variants for those four query IDs, so the
  generic platform skip removes working SQL coverage.

A manual proof on the reviewed tree showed DataFusion SQL query selection
includes all four query IDs, then the SQL adapter platform skip removes them:
  dialect_queries {'list_transform': True, 'list_filter': True, 'list_reduce': True, 'array_distinct': True}
  after_platform_filter {'list_transform': False, 'list_filter': False, 'list_reduce': False, 'array_distinct': False}
  count_delta 150 146

Two related skip-taxonomy issues should be fixed in the same narrow pass:
- `SKIP_FOR_EXPRESSION_FAMILY` currently contains map queries even though the
  stated reason is Polars' lack of native Map dtype; the shared expression
  helper has PySpark and DataFusion branches for `map_from_entries()`, so the
  family-wide bucket suppresses PySpark/DataFusion DataFrame coverage.
- PySpark DataFrame appears to need explicit handling for `list_filter` and
  `list_transform` because those expression implementations call
  `ctx.element()`, and only Polars overrides `element()`. DataFusion is covered
  by the DataFrame-specific skip list; PySpark currently is not.

anti_patterns.dont: broaden skips to whole categories like `lambda` or `map`
anti_patterns.instead: skip only the concrete unsupported query IDs
anti_patterns.why: the benchmark needs per-query capability accounting

anti_patterns.dont: fix the DataFusion SQL regression by special-casing DataFusion inside `PlatformAdapter._filter_queries()`
anti_patterns.instead: split the hook by execution mode instead
anti_patterns.why: the ambiguous hook would still leak future DataFrame-only skips into SQL

anti_patterns.dont: implement PySpark `element()` by returning a placeholder or Polars-like object
anti_patterns.instead: either skip those queries or implement native Spark expressions with behavioral tests
anti_patterns.why: Spark list transform/filter semantics must be real expressions

anti_patterns.instead: use a Polars-specific DataFrame skip bucket

anti_patterns.dont: move the four DataFusion DataFrame skips into read-primitives catalog `skip_on`
anti_patterns.instead: keep DataFrame-only skips in DataFrame dispatch
anti_patterns.why: the SQL catalog has working DataFusion variants

preserves.behavior: DataFusion DataFrame mode still skips `list_filter`, `list_transform`, `list_reduce`, and `array_distinct` until those DataFrame implementations are supported
DataFusion SQL read-primitives keeps the catalog variants for `array_distinct`, `list_transform`, `list_filter`, and `list_reduce`
Polars DataFrame mode still skips `map_construction`, `map_access`, and `map_keys_values` because Polars has no native Map dtype
PySpark and DataFusion DataFrame modes do not inherit Polars-only map skips via `SKIP_FOR_EXPRESSION_FAMILY`
Skip ID matching remains case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant in both SQL and DataFrame adapters
`ReadPrimitivesBenchmark.get_platform_skip_queries('LakeSail')` continues to skip `empty_build_join` for SQL mode

work_units.notes:
Keep `get_platform_skip_queries(platform_name)` for skips that are valid
for SQL execution too, such as the LakeSail `empty_build_join` skip. Add a
DataFrame-mode hook such as `get_dataframe_platform_skip_queries(platform_name)`
for DataFrame-only platform workarounds.
work_units.summary: Split SQL platform skips from DataFrame platform skips in the read-primitives benchmark API

work_units.notes:
`get_platform_skip_queries("DataFusion")` must no longer return
`list_filter`, `list_transform`, `list_reduce`, or `array_distinct` for
SQL mode. DataFusion DataFrame mode should still skip those four IDs via
the new DataFrame-specific platform hook until the underlying DataFrame
implementations are supported.
work_units.summary: Move DataFusion DataFrame skips out of the generic SQL-visible platform hook

work_units.notes:
`SKIP_FOR_EXPRESSION_FAMILY` should only contain queries unsupported by
all expression-family adapters. Move `map_construction`, `map_access`, and
`map_keys_values` to a Polars DataFrame platform skip list because the
stated blocker is Polars' lack of native Map dtype, while PySpark and
DataFusion have platform branches in `ExpressionFamilyContext.map_from_entries()`.
work_units.summary: Make expression-family skips truly family-wide and move Polars map skips to a platform-specific bucket

work_units.notes:
The narrow fix is to add `list_filter` and `list_transform` to a PySpark
DataFrame platform skip list because those implementations call
`ctx.element()` and PySpark does not override the default raising method.
If implementing PySpark-native transform/filter instead, do it only with
focused tests against Spark expression semantics; do not fake `element()`.
work_units.summary: Add explicit PySpark DataFrame handling for list_filter and list_transform

work_units.notes:
`_collect_skip_query_ids()` should keep the existing DataFrame-wide and
expression-family hooks, then union in platform skips from the new
DataFrame-only hook. It should not call `get_platform_skip_queries()` for
mode-specific DataFrame skip lists.
work_units.summary: Update the DataFrame benchmark mixin to consume the DataFrame-specific platform skip hook

work_units.notes:
Preserve the case-insensitive normalization added in 4a2b00043, but make
it defensive like the DataFrame mixin by normalizing with
`str(value).strip().lower()`. Do not use this as a workaround for the
DataFusion SQL regression; the mode split is still required.
work_units.summary: Harden SQL adapter skip normalization without changing its SQL-only platform skip semantics

work_units.notes:
Add a focused test that builds `ReadPrimitivesBenchmark().get_queries(dialect="datafusion")`
and then passes those queries through `PlatformAdapter._filter_queries()`
with `platform_name="DataFusion"`. Assert `list_filter`, `list_transform`,
`list_reduce`, and `array_distinct` survive filtering. Also assert the
LakeSail SQL skip remains effective for `empty_build_join`.
work_units.summary: Add SQL adapter regression tests proving DataFusion SQL keeps the four catalog-variant queries

work_units.notes:
Extend the DataFrame mixin tests beyond synthetic fixtures by using
`ReadPrimitivesBenchmark`. Assert DataFusion DataFrame skips the four
DataFusion-only IDs, Polars skips the three map IDs, PySpark skips
`list_filter`/`list_transform`, and PySpark/DataFusion do not inherit the
Polars map skips through an expression-family bucket.
work_units.summary: Add real-benchmark DataFrame skip-dispatch tests for DataFusion, Polars, and PySpark

work_units.notes:
